title: The Routine Workshop
description: A simple patrol first; optional routine experiments in the lab.
author: Luna Engine
opening_text: Keeper is ready for a short patrol. WAIT moves him to the Garden. GO GARDEN follows without spending a turn; WAIT twice, then once more to hear him, then once to see him return. The routine lab is optional: GO LAB, then HELP ROUTINE LAB.
help_text: Start with WAIT, GO GARDEN, WAIT, WAIT, WAIT, WAIT. LOOK, HELP and the room exits are free. For optional controls and experiments: GO LAB, HELP ROUTINE LAB. Restart the playtest or restore a named setup for each independent experiment.
